datasets.name: ds_demand_heatmap
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT pickup_hour, pickup_borough, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 6 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY pickup_hour, pickup_borough ORDER BY pickup_hour, pickup_borough

datasets.name: ds_underserved_zones
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT pickup_borough, pickup_zone, COUNT(*) AS trips_latest_day FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date = latest_date GROUP BY pickup_borough, pickup_zone HAVING COUNT(*) < 50 ORDER BY trips_latest_day ASC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_saturation
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT trip_date, pickup_borough, COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_zone) AS zones_active, SUM(CASE WHEN trip_count_per_zone > 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saturated_zones FROM (SELECT trip_date, pickup_borough, pickup_zone, COUNT(*) AS trip_count_per_zone FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 13 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY trip_date, pickup_borough, pickup_zone) zone_counts GROUP BY trip_date, pickup_borough ORDER BY trip_date DESC, pickup_borough

lines:
# Fleet Operations
Use the latest available 7-14 days of demand and saturation signals to redirect vehicles toward underserved zones.
